meta.style: chibi anime style, thick clean lineart, soft cel shading, colors exactly matching the reference character
meta.character: Use this exact character from the reference image: dark brown long wavy hair, white cat-print hoodie with cat paw cuffs, black pleated mini skirt, black ribbon bow and cat hairpin on hair, black platform shoes. Keep face, hairstyle, outfit, proportions and art style IDENTICAL to the reference.
meta.global: Full body visible and centered, feet on the ground line near the bottom, front view facing the viewer, isolated on fully transparent background, no scene, no floor, no text, no watermark. Loop-friendly: last keyframe should flow back into the first.
